mappings.reason: Controlled membrane tension belongs to the existing qualified resonant-percussion construction mechanism.
Named rules for coordinating independent lines specialize the shared multi-part composition practice; each convention does not add a separate universal discovery.
Qualified compositional analysis uses existing analytical methods; a paint-specific sample does not create another spectroscopic mechanism.
Testing reversal limits and preserving future choices applies the existing staged intervention method; conservation still needs material-specific trials.

prior_branch_corrections.change: Permit empirical ensemble comparison before formal ratio theory.

scope_distinctions.distinction: A shared air-displacement mechanism differs from routing and regulating air among an actual instrument array.
A record of demonstrated tasks, an estimate of measurement repeatability and evidence of performance on changed tasks are different mechanisms; no credential grants every competence.
Delayed recall, discrimination among mixed task types and progressive removal of supplied solution steps change different learning conditions; benefits require actual assessment.
